events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Chrissie Hynde on her 75th birthday. Her voice, her style, her songs – truly a rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that unmistakable swagger and voice to the world.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (single) released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK 51 years ago today in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine' in the UK. A song whose message of peace and unity remains as powerful today as ever.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: The original Apple iPod was introduced 25 years ago today, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod. Remember life before it? It completely changed our music habits forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film, the best theme tune, or the ultimate 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter and The Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showcased the band's incredible range. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45 in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Evolutionary Album
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant artistic leap for the Fab Four.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon at the age of 40 in 1980.

angles.name: Peace and Music
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on from his passing. His legacy of peace and revolutionary music lives on.
